gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-poly: Expressive tubing-like letters lead in Balsamiq Sans, bent without a single pinched curve. Poly, a classic serif with a mild stress in its o and e, settles into a literary rhythm that carries paragraph after paragraph without tiring.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-quattrocento: Balsamiq Sans draws everything with the steadiness of a technical pen. Quattrocento keeps its thin strokes clearly thinner yet never fragile against that steady line, which is the pair's best trick.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-radley: Balsamiq Sans has stems with no hairlines at all, just one plain line. Radley, a classic serif, reads with a gentle gradient of weight along each rounded stroke, so pages of it feel dignified without turning stiff.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-roboto-serif: Roboto Serif sets its letters well apart, with generous eyes on every e and a. And Balsamiq Sans above it holds one constant line width, so the heading's plainness meets the body's modest dips.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-sahitya: Round, stencil-bold letters from Balsamiq Sans, with bowls matching the stems. Sahitya sits beside them like a text serif touched by a barely pressed round brush, restrained and bookish.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-sawarabi-mincho: Refined terminals cut well short of the bowl give Sawarabi Mincho its text serif poise. But Balsamiq Sans keeps tails and terminals thick, and that chunky-versus-fine split is the pair's whole appeal.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-sedan: Sedan reads like a soft pencil, gentle in its thick-thin shifts. And down a full page, its mellow weights carry on without wearing, while Balsamiq Sans stays plain and constant.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-sedan-sc: Round, unshaded letters in Balsamiq Sans, then Sedan SC arriving with broad open counters and mild shifts in stroke weight. That literary softness against plain lines is the draw.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-shippori-mincho: Balsamiq Sans looks like bent tubing, every letter at a constant weight, while Shippori Mincho keeps generous openings in every curve. Give the serif body a touch more size so its modest contrast shows.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-shippori-mincho-: Shippori Mincho B1 is a refined text serif, its c opened wide like a crescent wrench. But Balsamiq Sans, drawn with one fixed nib, brings the real hook: unvarying line against fine detail.
